base_cache_dir.description: Location of the cache where downloaded files are kept ($DEBUGINFOD_CACHE_PATH).

cache_max_age.description: Rescan time for the file and archive directories in seconds.

db_path.description: Path of the sqlite database used to store the index.

fdcache_mbs.description: Cache limit in megabytes for recently extracted files from archives.

fdcache_mintmp.description: Disk space threshold percentage for emergency flushing of the caches.

fdcache_prefetch.description: Number of other files from an archive to prefetch into the cache.

listen_address.description: IP address the server binds to. Both IPv4 and IPv6 sockets are opened if possible.

listen_port.description: TCP port number on which debuginfod should listen.

log_level.description: Verbosity of logging. 0 is default. Increase to add details.

max_cache_size.description: Groom time for the index database in seconds.

max_connections.description: Size of the pool of threads serving webapi queries (0 for automatic). Minimum 2 if specified.

metadata_maxtime.description: Limit on the runtime of metadata webapi queries in seconds. Set 0 to disable.

passive.description: Set the server to passive mode, where it only services webapi requests.

scan_checkpoint.description: Run a synchronized SQLITE WAL checkpoint operation after every NUM completed archive or file scans. 0 to disable.

tmp_dir.description: File system to be used for temporary files ($TMPDIR).

upstream_sources.description: List of URL prefixes for trusted debuginfod instances ($DEBUGINFOD_URLS).

worker_count.description: Concurrency limit for the scanning queue threads. The default is related to the number of processors; minimum is 1.
